description: Inspecciones de prevención de incendios is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Madrid. NOTE: Since 2024 there has been a change in the structure of the data file that adds new fields. Files for fire prevention inspections prior to 2024 follow the previous structure. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Madrid. The portal shows the English title as "Fire prevention inspections" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Madrid. Its keywords include seguridad, inspecciones, emergencias. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. The listing shows 2026-09-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
